content.text: The Full List With Context

1. **Own Your Infrastructure**: Platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy rent you space. COREMERCH deploys stacks you own entirely—no subscriptions, no access revocation. 2. **Crypto Payments Are Non-Negotiable**: NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. 3. **Instant Product Delivery**: Automate file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 the moment payment confirms on-chain. 4. **Order Storage Sovereignty**: Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store orders—no third-party databases. 5. **Global Hosting, Zero Fees**: Deploy on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free, scalable hosting. 6. **Email Deliverability Configured**: SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup ensures your order confirmations land in inboxes, not spam. 7. **Lifetime Access, No Subscriptions**: Once deployed, the stack is yours forever. No recurring fees, no platform dependencies.
Why Each Item on This List Matters

Owning your infrastructure means no platform can shut you down. Crypto payments remove geographic barriers—buyers from anywhere can purchase using BSC, Solana, or TRON for fees under $0.10. Instant product delivery eliminates manual intervention, scaling your business passively. Order storage sovereignty ensures your data isn’t held hostage by third parties. Free global hosting reduces costs to zero while maintaining performance. Email deliverability is critical—90% of digital product sales fail due to missed confirmations. Lifetime access eliminates recurring costs, ensuring profitability from day one. Each element is designed to create a self-sustaining commerce stack that operates independently of financial or geographic restrictions.
The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Most creators underestimate the importance of email deliverability. Without SPF/DKIM/DMARC, your order emails will fail silently. Another mistake is relying on manual file delivery—this doesn’t scale. Crypto payment integration is often botched due to poor webhook configuration. NOWPayments’ automatic webhook fires the moment payment confirms on-chain, solving this. Finally, many creators choose expensive hosting solutions when GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are free and sufficient. These errors turn a sovereign stack into a fragile workaround. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints to avoid these pitfalls, ensuring deployment success.
Deploy in 48 hours—no coding required.
How to Prioritise What to Implement First

Start with crypto payment integration—without it, you cannot sell globally. Next, configure instant product delivery to eliminate manual work. Then, set up order storage to track sales without relying on third parties. Hosting should be your fourth priority—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are free and reliable. Email deliverability is fifth—essential but not urgent if you’re testing. Finally, ensure lifetime access by deploying on infrastructure you own. The Complete Builder Kit provides all templates and blueprints in a single download, streamlining this process.
